titleEs: Path of Building for Last Epoch vs Last Epoch Tools planner — qué planner usar
titleEn: Path of Building for Last Epoch vs Last Epoch Tools planner — which planner to use
descriptionEs: Dos planners de Last Epoch con propuestas opuestas. PoB-LE prioriza profundidad de simulación; LE Tools prioriza visualización y community sharing.
descriptionEn: Two Last Epoch planners with opposing propositions. PoB-LE prioritizes simulation depth; LE Tools prioritizes visualization and community sharing.
verdictEs: PoB for LE si necesitas DPS exacto, comparison item-vs-item con delta calculado, o validar claims de creators. LE Tools si quieres UI amigable, sharear via URL, o iterar visual rápido. Theorycrafters usan los dos: LE Tools para draft, PoB para validar antes de spendear gold en crafting.
verdictEn: PoB for LE if you need exact DPS, item-vs-item comparison with computed delta, or to validate creator claims. LE Tools if you want a friendly UI, share via URL, or iterate visually fast. Theorycrafters use both: LE Tools to draft, PoB to validate before spending gold on crafting.

useCases.labelEs: DPS simulation exacto con ailments y multipliers
useCases.labelEn: Exact DPS simulation with ailments and multipliers
useCases.reasonEs: PoB-LE simula shock stacks, ignite stacking, DOT multipliers, conditional damage y defense layer order con precision real. LE Tools aproxima estos cálculos.
useCases.reasonEn: PoB-LE simulates shock stacks, ignite stacking, DOT multipliers, conditional damage, and defense-layer order with real precision. LE Tools approximates these calculations.

useCases.labelEs: Share build via URL para Discord/Reddit
useCases.labelEn: Share build via URL for Discord/Reddit
useCases.reasonEs: LE Tools genera URL única por build instantly. PoB usa "build codes" que son strings largos menos amigables para link en chat.
useCases.reasonEn: LE Tools generates a unique URL per build instantly. PoB uses "build codes" that are long strings less friendly to link in chat.

useCases.labelEs: Compare 2 items side-by-side con delta exacto
useCases.labelEn: Compare 2 items side-by-side with exact delta
useCases.reasonEs: PoB-LE permite equip item A, swap por item B y ver delta de cada stat. LE Tools require manual comparison entre tabs.
useCases.reasonEn: PoB-LE lets you equip item A, swap for item B, and see the delta on every stat. LE Tools requires manual comparison across tabs.

useCases.reasonEs: LE Tools UI es más amigable: drag/drop gear, click-to-allocate pasivas, stats update visible. PoB hereda UI compleja de PoB PoE con curva de aprendizaje empinada.
useCases.reasonEn: LE Tools UI is friendlier: drag/drop gear, click-to-allocate passives, stats update visible. PoB inherits PoB PoE's complex UI with steep learning curve.

useCases.reasonEs: PoB-LE desktop corre 100% offline. LE Tools es web-only — sin internet, no puedes acceder a tu build ni iterar.
useCases.reasonEn: PoB-LE desktop runs 100% offline. LE Tools is web-only — without internet, you can't access your build or iterate.
